items.title: FDA requires vision-loss warning on Novo Nordisk and Eli Lilly GLP-1 drugs
items.summary: Investing.com -- U.S. health regulators will require drugmakers including Novo Nordisk A/S (NYSE:NVO) and Eli Lilly and Company (NYSE:LLY) to add safety warnings to their blockbuster weight-loss and diabetes treatments regarding a rare eye condition that can cause permanent vision loss. items.title: Eli Lilly (LLY) Opens Digital Access To Obesity Drugs Across The US
items.summary: Eli Lilly (NYSE:LLY) has partnered with Hims & Hers Health and LifeMD to widen access to its GLP-1 obesity drugs in the US. The agreements give eligible adults nationwide direct digital access to Zepbound and Foundayo through telehealth consultations and online prescribing. Both collaborations exclude compounded versions of GLP-1 therapies and focus on prescription, pharmacy fulfillment and home delivery of branded products.
